launch-tx-san-antonio-brackenridge-park.address: 3700 North St. Mary's Street, San Antonio, TX 78209
launch-tx-san-antonio-brackenridge-park.summary: San Antonio's historic river park and attraction district with shaded picnics, walking trails, fishing, playground access, historic structures, Japanese Tea Garden, train, zoo, Witte Museum, golf, and nearby gardens.
launch-tx-san-antonio-brackenridge-park.hours: The general park is free and open daily 5:00 a.m.-11:00 p.m.; individual attractions keep separate hours.
launch-tx-san-antonio-brackenridge-park.parking: Parking is free but distributed across the large district. Route directly to the Japanese Tea Garden, zoo, Witte Museum, Lions Field, train, golf course, or pavilion rather than using one general pin.
launch-tx-san-antonio-brackenridge-park.arrival: Use 3700 North St. Mary's Street only as a general reference. Park roads, river crossings, attractions, and reserved areas have distinct entrances.
launch-tx-san-antonio-brackenridge-park.restrooms: Public restrooms and fountains are shown on the current park map at selected nodes; attractions maintain their own facilities during operating hours.
launch-tx-san-antonio-brackenridge-park.cost: General park and Japanese Tea Garden access are free. Zoo, Witte Museum, train, golf, food, reservations, and events charge separately.
launch-tx-san-antonio-brackenridge-park.accessibility: Major attractions and lots provide accessible routes, but river trails, historic structures, grades, crossings, and long distances vary.
launch-tx-san-antonio-brackenridge-park.dogs: Leashed dogs may use ordinary park areas; individual attractions, train, food areas, playgrounds, and events may prohibit them.
launch-tx-san-antonio-brackenridge-park.family: Picnics, train, zoo, Japanese Tea Garden, Lions Field playground, river walks, and museums provide many family options but are spread across a large area.
launch-tx-san-antonio-brackenridge-park.transit: VIA routes, biking, rideshare, and nearby corridor connections serve the district; choose the exact destination before planning transit.
launch-tx-san-antonio-brackenridge-park.need: There is no current public swimming area or splash pad in Brackenridge Park, and river swimming is prohibited. Check attraction hours, construction, events, river conditions, and the current map before travel.

launch-tx-san-antonio-hemisfair.address: 600 Hemisfair Plaza Way, San Antonio, TX 78205
launch-tx-san-antonio-hemisfair.summary: Downtown public park district with inclusive Yanaguana Garden play, seasonal splash pad, sand and games, Civic Park's Great Lawn and shallow water features, public art, historic houses, restaurants, events, and accessible paths.
launch-tx-san-antonio-hemisfair.hours: Open daily 5:00 a.m.-11:00 p.m.; splash pads operate 9:00 a.m.-9:00 p.m. March-October, subject to weather and maintenance.
launch-tx-san-antonio-hemisfair.parking: Use downtown garages, metered parking, transit, rideshare, or walking connections. Event and convention schedules can change prices, access, and availability.
launch-tx-san-antonio-hemisfair.arrival: Use 600 Hemisfair Plaza Way for the district, then select Yanaguana Garden, Civic Park, Tower Park, or a restaurant for the closest approach.
launch-tx-san-antonio-hemisfair.restrooms: Public restrooms and fountains are available within the district, with additional facilities tied to restaurants and events.
launch-tx-san-antonio-hemisfair.cost: General park, playground, splash pad, lawns, water features, and many programs are free; food, parking, rentals, and ticketed events cost separately.
launch-tx-san-antonio-hemisfair.accessibility: Inclusive play equipment, paved paths, accessible parking, restrooms, seating, and level lawns support varied visits; event layouts may alter routes.
launch-tx-san-antonio-hemisfair.dogs: Leashed dogs may use ordinary park paths and lawns but should stay out of play equipment, splash areas, water features, food spaces, and restricted events.
launch-tx-san-antonio-hemisfair.family: Yanaguana Garden, sand, games, seasonal splash pad, Civic Park water features, lawns, restaurants, and restrooms make this a strong downtown family base.
launch-tx-san-antonio-hemisfair.transit: Downtown VIA routes, walking, biking, and rideshare connect Hemisfair to the River Walk, convention center, and nearby attractions.
launch-tx-san-antonio-hemisfair.need: Verify splash-pad status, event setup, and heat conditions. The shallow Civic Park Springs invite contact but follow posted rules; the splash pad has the clear seasonal operating schedule.

launch-tx-san-antonio-phil-hardberger-pa.address: 13203 Blanco Road and 8400 NW Military Highway, San Antonio, TX
launch-tx-san-antonio-phil-hardberger-pa.summary: A 311-acre natural-area park on both sides of Wurzbach Parkway with wooded trails, two playgrounds, two dog parks, nature play, picnic areas, Urban Ecology Center, Salado Creek Greenway access, and the Tobin Land Bridge and Skywalk.
launch-tx-san-antonio-phil-hardberger-pa.hours: Open sunrise to sunset daily; both dog parks are also open sunrise to sunset.
launch-tx-san-antonio-phil-hardberger-pa.parking: Choose the east entrance at 13203 Blanco Road or west entrance at 8400 NW Military Highway based on the feature you want. The Land Bridge connects the two sides on foot, not by moving your parked car.
launch-tx-san-antonio-phil-hardberger-pa.arrival: Use the official map before driving. Playgrounds, dog parks, Urban Ecology Center, trailheads, Land Bridge, and greenway connections are split between east and west.
launch-tx-san-antonio-phil-hardberger-pa.restrooms: Restrooms, portable toilets, fountains, and parking are available at developed nodes, not along every natural trail.
launch-tx-san-antonio-phil-hardberger-pa.cost: General park, trails, Land Bridge, Skywalk, playgrounds, dog parks, and picnic use are free; reservations and programs may charge.
launch-tx-san-antonio-phil-hardberger-pa.accessibility: Developed areas and the Land Bridge have accessible routes, while natural trails vary in width, slope, rock, roots, and weather impacts.
launch-tx-san-antonio-phil-hardberger-pa.dogs: Dogs may use designated off-leash parks on both sides and must be leashed elsewhere. Separate small- and all-dog areas are provided.
launch-tx-san-antonio-phil-hardberger-pa.family: Nature play, two playgrounds, Land Bridge wildlife crossings, Skywalk, short trails, picnics, and ecology programs suit families; there is no splash pad or pool.
launch-tx-san-antonio-phil-hardberger-pa.transit: This is primarily a driving or biking destination. Select east or west before routing and account for the long internal trail connection.
launch-tx-san-antonio-phil-hardberger-pa.need: Treat Hardberger as a natural-area park, not a water-play destination. Stay on designated trails, carry water, avoid midday heat, and leave before sunset.

launch-tx-san-antonio-san-antonio-river-.address: San Antonio River Walk, San Antonio, TX 78205
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-antonio-river-.summary: A multi-part public river corridor connecting downtown restaurants and landmarks with Museum Reach, Pearl, public art, boat landings, parks, and the daylight-only Mission Reach trail toward the historic missions.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-antonio-river-.hours: Downtown River Walk and Museum Reach are open 24 hours; Mission Reach is open daylight hours only. Businesses, boats, restrooms, parks, and attractions keep separate schedules.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-antonio-river-.parking: There is no single River Walk lot. Choose a downtown garage, hotel, Museum Reach, Pearl, or Mission Reach trailhead based on the segment you intend to visit.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-antonio-river-.arrival: Select a landmark or access stair/elevator rather than navigating to the river generally. Street level and river level are different and not every crossing is accessible.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-antonio-river-.restrooms: Public restroom availability varies by segment and hour; downtown visitors often rely on operating attractions, garages, visitor facilities, and businesses.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-antonio-river-.cost: Walking the public River Walk is free. Parking, boat tours, food, museums, attractions, rentals, and events charge separately.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-antonio-river-.accessibility: Many major access points include ramps or elevators, but some historic stairs, narrow sections, crowding, construction, and river-level changes require route planning.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-antonio-river-.dogs: Leashed dogs are allowed in public outdoor sections where posted rules permit; businesses, boats, events, and crowded interiors have separate policies.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-antonio-river-.family: Short downtown loops, boat watching, public art, Museum Reach, Pearl, and selected Mission Reach segments work well; railings do not replace close supervision at the water edge.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-antonio-river-.transit: VIA, downtown walking, biking, rideshare, and river-adjacent trails reach many sections. Plan start and finish locations because the corridor is long.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-antonio-river-.need: The River Walk is not one uniform attraction. Downtown can be crowded and open all night, while Mission Reach closes at dark and may flood; check weather, river closures, construction, and exact access points.

launch-tx-san-antonio-san-antonio-missio.address: 6701 San Jose Drive, San Antonio, TX 78214
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-antonio-missio.summary: The National Park Service preserves four Spanish colonial mission communities, cultural landscapes, acequias, exhibits, trails, churches, ranger programs, and the Mission Reach connection within Texas's only UNESCO World Heritage Site.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-antonio-missio.hours: Park facilities are generally open 9:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m.; Mission San Juan and Mission Espada contact stations are 10:00 a.m.-4:30 p.m. Grounds are sunrise to sunset and close on Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Year's Day.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-antonio-missio.parking: Free parking is available at each mission. The four sites are about 2.5 miles apart, so select Mission Concepcion, San Jose, San Juan, or Espada before driving.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-antonio-missio.arrival: Start at Mission San Jose for the main visitor center, park store, film, Junior Ranger materials, and orientation, then drive or bike between mission districts.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-antonio-missio.restrooms: Restrooms are available at mission contact stations during operating hours; the Espada Aqueduct has no restrooms, water, or picnic facilities.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-antonio-missio.cost: Park admission, parking, ranger programs, and the mission grounds are free; donations, store purchases, bike rentals, and external tours cost separately.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-antonio-missio.accessibility: Each mission has documented accessible parking and paths, but historic thresholds, churches, gravel, nature trails, aqueduct sites, and slopes vary.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-antonio-missio.dogs: Leashed pets may use allowed outdoor park areas; they are restricted from buildings and must not disturb worship, wildlife, visitors, or historic resources.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-antonio-missio.family: Junior Ranger activities, ranger walks, courtyards, exhibits, acequias, farms, and short trails support family visits; children must not climb ruins or aqueducts.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-antonio-missio.transit: VIA Route 42 serves Mission Concepcion and Mission San Jose. B-cycle and Mission Reach connect all four, while driving is simplest for a multi-site visit.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-antonio-missio.need: The Alamo is part of the World Heritage designation but is not managed as part of this national park. Mission churches remain active congregations; respect services and verify each contact station's shorter hours.

launch-tx-san-antonio-san-pedro-springs-.address: 1315 San Pedro Avenue, San Antonio, TX 78212
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-pedro-springs-.summary: San Antonio's oldest public park centers on historic springs and a tree-lined pool, with two miles of paths, gazebo, playground, skate plaza, tennis, library, playhouse, picnics, restrooms, and deep cultural history.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-pedro-springs-.hours: Park hours are 5:00 a.m.-11:00 p.m. daily. During the current 2026 outdoor season, San Pedro Springs Pool is posted open 1:00-8:00 p.m. daily except Tuesday, subject to staffing, weather, maintenance, and seasonal changes.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-pedro-springs-.parking: Use 1315 San Pedro Avenue for the general park, 2200 North Flores for the pool, or the named library, playhouse, tennis, or skate destination for closer access.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-pedro-springs-.arrival: The pool, springs, library, playhouse, tennis center, playground, and skate plaza occupy different edges of the historic landscape.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-pedro-springs-.restrooms: Park restrooms and pool facilities are available according to posted schedules; library and playhouse facilities are not substitutes outside their operating hours.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-pedro-springs-.cost: General park, springs, paths, playground, and skate plaza are free. Pool policies, tennis, performances, reservations, and programs may charge.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-pedro-springs-.accessibility: Developed paths, parking, pool, and civic facilities provide accessible options, while historic landscaping and spring edges vary.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-pedro-springs-.dogs: Leashed dogs may use ordinary park areas but not the swimming pool, play equipment, or restricted indoor and event spaces.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-pedro-springs-.family: The shaded pool, springs, playground, skate plaza, library, theater, and paths offer variety, but verify seasonal pool operation before promising swimming.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-pedro-springs-.transit: VIA routes serve San Pedro Avenue and surrounding civic destinations; select the exact park edge for the nearest stop.
launch-tx-san-antonio-san-pedro-springs-.need: The springs and decorative water are not substitutes for the staffed pool. Check current pool status, drought and spring-flow conditions, events, and heat before visiting.

launch-tx-san-antonio-pearsall-park.address: 5102 Old Pearsall Road, San Antonio, TX 78242
launch-tx-san-antonio-pearsall-park.summary: A 505-acre destination park transformed from a former landfill with large playground and splash pads, the City's largest skate park, dog park, 18-hole disc golf, 5K trail routes, sprint timer, zip line, fitness challenges, public art, overlooks, and event space.
launch-tx-san-antonio-pearsall-park.hours: Open daily 5:00 a.m.-11:00 p.m.; splash pads operate 9:00 a.m.-9:00 p.m. March-October, subject to weather and maintenance.
launch-tx-san-antonio-pearsall-park.parking: Large amenities are spread across multiple lots. Navigate to the splash pad and playground, skate park, dog park, disc golf, trail, or overlook rather than stopping at the first entrance.
launch-tx-san-antonio-pearsall-park.arrival: Use the official park map because the 505-acre site has separated activity zones and significant distances between them.
launch-tx-san-antonio-pearsall-park.restrooms: Restrooms, portable toilets, fountains, Wi-Fi, parking, and picnic facilities are provided at developed activity nodes, not across every trail segment.
launch-tx-san-antonio-pearsall-park.cost: General park, splash pads, playground, skate park, dog park, disc golf, trails, fitness equipment, and public art are free; events and reservations may charge.
launch-tx-san-antonio-pearsall-park.accessibility: Developed zones include accessible parking and routes, rubber play surfacing, paved trails, and seating; hills, disc golf, natural surfaces, and long distances vary.
launch-tx-san-antonio-pearsall-park.dogs: The 1.5-acre dog park combines large and small dog use; dogs must be leashed elsewhere and kept out of splash and playground zones.
launch-tx-san-antonio-pearsall-park.family: Splash pads, playground, zip line, terrain play, swings, trails, fitness challenges, and public art make this a full-day family destination when heat is managed.
launch-tx-san-antonio-pearsall-park.transit: This is primarily a driving destination. Select the activity zone before routing and arrange pickup carefully because the park is large.
launch-tx-san-antonio-pearsall-park.need: Shade is limited in many major activity zones. Bring water, verify splash-pad status, check surface heat, and do not assume the playground, skate park, and fitness areas share one parking lot.

launch-tx-san-antonio-woodlawn-lake-park.summary: A century-old community lake park with paved loop, seasonal public pool, playground, dog park, lighthouse and island, fishing, fitness stations, gym, sports courts, picnic facilities, public art, and major civic events.
launch-tx-san-antonio-woodlawn-lake-park.hours: Open daily 5:00 a.m.-midnight. Pool hours are seasonal; current posted open swim is 1:00-8:00 p.m. daily except Monday, with weekday morning lap swim.
launch-tx-san-antonio-woodlawn-lake-park.parking: Use 1103 Cincinnati Avenue for the general park, 221 Alexander Avenue for the pool, or select the Island House, gym, dog park, playground, or sports destination.
launch-tx-san-antonio-woodlawn-lake-park.arrival: The lake loop connects several distinct facility clusters. Large events, especially July Fourth, substantially change road and parking access.
launch-tx-san-antonio-woodlawn-lake-park.restrooms: Restrooms, portable toilets, fountains, gym, pool facilities, and parking are available at developed nodes according to their schedules.
launch-tx-san-antonio-woodlawn-lake-park.cost: General park, loop, playground, dog park, fishing, fitness stations, and picnic use are free; pool rules, programs, reservations, and events may charge.
launch-tx-san-antonio-woodlawn-lake-park.accessibility: Paved trail, accessible parking, fitness nodes, pool, community facilities, seating, and restrooms support varied visits; event detours and older edges vary.
launch-tx-san-antonio-woodlawn-lake-park.dogs: Dogs may use the designated off-leash park and must be leashed elsewhere. Keep pets out of the pool, playground, sports areas, and unsafe lake water.
launch-tx-san-antonio-woodlawn-lake-park.family: The loop, playground, seasonal pool, ducks, lighthouse, picnics, fishing, fitness, and sports create many family options in one neighborhood destination.
launch-tx-san-antonio-woodlawn-lake-park.transit: VIA routes serve surrounding streets; check the exact facility and current event detours before selecting a stop.
launch-tx-san-antonio-woodlawn-lake-park.need: Swimming is allowed only in the staffed pool, not the lake. Verify seasonal pool status and expect extreme crowding and access changes during major civic events.
